---
title: "Matrix-aware tests of cross-omics Bray-Curtis concordance"
format: html
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

Run with `bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/community_cross_omics_permutation_tests.qmd NEW_OUTPUT`.
Tests the three descriptive cross-assay Spearman correlations without treating
the 66 pairwise distances as independent observations. The global test uses
99,999 random sample-label permutations. The design-constrained sensitivity
enumerates all 6^4 = 1,296 permutations of cycle labels within each condition
by phase stratum. Both tests are two-sided. Benjamini-Hochberg correction is
applied across the three assay comparisons separately for each permutation
scheme.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(digest)
})

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(args)==1L)
out <- args[[1L]]
stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
repo <- normalizePath(getwd())
source(file.path(repo,"R/figure_style.R"))
root <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
source_root <- file.path(root,"derived/community_cross_omics_2026-09-15-v3")
paths <- c(
  MG=file.path(source_root,"MG_relative_profile.tsv"),
  MT=file.path(source_root,"MT_relative_profile.tsv"),
  `16S`=file.path(source_root,"16S_relative_profile.tsv"),
  metadata=file.path(repo,"metadata/sample_metadata.tsv"),
  notebook=Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH")
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(paths)))
dir.create(file.path(out,"tables"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(out,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
sha <- function(p) digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
hashes <- vapply(paths,sha,character(1))
fwrite(data.table(source=names(paths),path=paths,sha256=hashes),
       file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")

meta <- fread(paths[["metadata"]])[,.(sample_title,condition,phase,cycle)]
setorder(meta,condition,phase,cycle)
stopifnot(nrow(meta)==12L,!anyDuplicated(meta$sample_title),
          all(table(meta$condition,meta$phase,meta$cycle)==1L))
samples <- meta$sample_title
read_profile <- function(p) {
  x <- fread(p)
  stopifnot(all(samples %in% names(x)))
  m <- as.matrix(x[,..samples])
  rownames(m) <- x[[1L]]
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(m)),all(m>=0),max(abs(colSums(m)-1))<1e-10)
  m
}
profiles <- lapply(paths[c("MG","MT","16S")],read_profile)

bray <- function(m) {
  n <- ncol(m)
  d <- matrix(0,n,n,dimnames=list(colnames(m),colnames(m)))
  for(i in seq_len(n-1L)) for(j in (i+1L):n) {
    z <- sum(abs(m[,i]-m[,j])) / sum(m[,i]+m[,j])
    d[i,j] <- d[j,i] <- z
  }
  d
}
distances <- lapply(profiles,bray)
lower <- lower.tri(distances[[1L]])
rank_matrix <- function(d) {
  r <- matrix(NA_real_,nrow(d),ncol(d),dimnames=dimnames(d))
  r[lower] <- rank(d[lower],ties.method="average")
  r[upper.tri(r)] <- t(r)[upper.tri(r)]
  diag(r) <- 0
  r
}
ranks <- lapply(distances,rank_matrix)

# Global Monte Carlo permutations. Plus-one correction yields valid finite-sample
# Monte Carlo p-values and a minimum attainable p of 1e-5.
set.seed(20260916L)
B_global <- 99999L
global_permutations <- replicate(B_global,sample.int(nrow(meta)),simplify="matrix")

# Exact cycle-label permutations within the four condition-by-phase strata.
groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(meta)),interaction(meta$condition,meta$phase,drop=TRUE))
stopifnot(length(groups)==4L,all(lengths(groups)==3L))
perm3 <- rbind(c(1L,2L,3L),c(1L,3L,2L),c(2L,1L,3L),
               c(2L,3L,1L),c(3L,1L,2L),c(3L,2L,1L))
choices <- as.matrix(expand.grid(rep(list(seq_len(nrow(perm3))),length(groups))))
constrained_permutations <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(choices)),function(i) {
  p <- seq_len(nrow(meta))
  for(g in seq_along(groups)) {
    idx <- groups[[g]]
    p[idx] <- idx[perm3[choices[i,g],]]
  }
  p
},integer(nrow(meta)))
stopifnot(ncol(constrained_permutations)==1296L,
          uniqueN(as.data.table(t(constrained_permutations)))==1296L,
          any(apply(constrained_permutations,2,identical,seq_len(nrow(meta)))))
for(p in seq_len(ncol(constrained_permutations))) for(idx in groups)
  stopifnot(setequal(constrained_permutations[idx,p],idx))

pair_specs <- list(c("MG","MT"),c("MG","16S"),c("MT","16S"))
null_rows <- list()
results <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(pair_specs),function(k) {
  pair <- pair_specs[[k]]
  r1 <- ranks[[pair[[1L]]]][lower]
  r2 <- ranks[[pair[[2L]]]]
  observed <- cor(r1,r2[lower],method="pearson")
  permuted <- function(pm) apply(pm,2L,function(p) cor(r1,r2[p,p][lower],method="pearson"))
  global_null <- permuted(global_permutations)
  constrained_null <- permuted(constrained_permutations)
  null_rows[[length(null_rows)+1L]] <<- data.table(
    assay1=pair[[1L]],assay2=pair[[2L]],scheme="global",rho=global_null)
  null_rows[[length(null_rows)+1L]] <<- data.table(
    assay1=pair[[1L]],assay2=pair[[2L]],scheme="condition_phase_constrained",rho=constrained_null)
  data.table(
    assay1=pair[[1L]],assay2=pair[[2L]],n_samples=nrow(meta),n_distances=sum(lower),
    spearman_rho=observed,global_permutations=B_global,
    global_p=(1+sum(abs(global_null)>=abs(observed)-1e-12))/(B_global+1),
    constrained_permutations=ncol(constrained_permutations),
    constrained_p=mean(abs(constrained_null)>=abs(observed)-1e-12)
  )
}))
results[,global_q_BH:=p.adjust(global_p,"BH")]
results[,constrained_q_BH:=p.adjust(constrained_p,"BH")]
results[,`:=`(alternative="two-sided",correlation="Spearman")]
setcolorder(results,c("assay1","assay2","n_samples","n_distances","spearman_rho",
 "global_permutations","global_p","global_q_BH","constrained_permutations",
 "constrained_p","constrained_q_BH","alternative","correlation"))
fwrite(results,file.path(out,"tables/bray_curtis_matrix_permutation_tests.tsv"),sep="\t")
nulls <- rbindlist(null_rows)
null_summary <- nulls[,.(null_mean=mean(rho),null_sd=sd(rho),
 q025=quantile(rho,.025),q50=quantile(rho,.5),q975=quantile(rho,.975)),
 by=.(assay1,assay2,scheme)]
fwrite(null_summary,file.path(out,"tables/permutation_null_summary.tsv"),sep="\t")

fmt <- function(x) ifelse(x<.0001,format(x,scientific=TRUE,digits=2),sprintf("%.4f",x))
md <- c(
  "# Cross-assay Bray-Curtis concordance", "",
  "| Comparison | Spearman rho | Global P | Global FDR (BH) | Constrained P | Constrained FDR (BH) |",
  "|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
  sprintf("| %s–%s | %.3f | %s | %s | %s | %s |",results$assay1,results$assay2,
          results$spearman_rho,fmt(results$global_p),fmt(results$global_q_BH),
          fmt(results$constrained_p),fmt(results$constrained_q_BH)), "",
  sprintf("Global: %s random label permutations. Constrained: all %s cycle-label permutations within condition × phase strata. Two-sided tests; BH correction across three assay comparisons separately for each scheme.",
          format(B_global,big.mark=","),format(ncol(constrained_permutations),big.mark=","))
)
writeLines(md,file.path(out,"tables/bray_curtis_matrix_permutation_tests.md"))

plot_data <- results[,.(comparison=factor(paste(assay1,assay2,sep=" / "),
 levels=rev(paste(assay1,assay2,sep=" / "))),spearman_rho)]
plot_data[,rho_label:=sprintf("rho == %.3f",spearman_rho)]
q_data <- melt(results[,.(comparison=paste(assay1,assay2,sep=" / "),
 Global=global_q_BH,`Condition x phase constrained`=constrained_q_BH)],
 id.vars="comparison",variable.name="scheme",value.name="q")
q_data[,comparison:=factor(comparison,levels=levels(plot_data$comparison))]
q_data[,label:=paste0("FDR (BH) = ",fmt(q))]
theme_set(theme_phage_uv(base_size=8,base_family="Helvetica"))
a <- ggplot(plot_data,aes(spearman_rho,comparison))+
  geom_segment(aes(x=0,xend=spearman_rho,yend=comparison),linewidth=.65,colour="#B0BEC5")+
  geom_point(size=2.8,colour="#355070")+
  geom_text(aes(label=rho_label),hjust=1.18,size=2.7,parse=TRUE)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,1.08),breaks=c(0,.25,.5,.75,1),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.01)))+
  labs(x="Spearman correlation of Bray-Curtis matrices",y=NULL)+
  theme(plot.margin=margin(5,12,4,5))
b <- ggplot(q_data,aes(-log10(q),comparison,shape=scheme,colour=scheme))+
  geom_vline(xintercept=-log10(.05),linetype="dashed",linewidth=.5,colour="#777777")+
  geom_point(size=2.5,stroke=.8)+
  geom_text(aes(label=label),hjust=-.12,size=2.5,show.legend=FALSE)+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(Global="#355070",`Condition x phase constrained`="#E76F51"))+
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(Global=16,`Condition x phase constrained`=17))+
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(.02,.34)))+
  labs(x="-log10 FDR (BH)",y=NULL,colour=NULL,shape=NULL)+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",plot.margin=margin(5,32,4,5))
fig <- a+b+plot_layout(widths=c(1,1.12))+plot_annotation(tag_levels="A")
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/bray_curtis_concordance_tests.pdf"),fig,
       width=180,height=78,units="mm",device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/bray_curtis_concordance_tests.png"),fig,
       width=180,height=78,units="mm",dpi=300,bg="white",device=ragg::agg_png)
writeLines(c(
  "# Figure caption", "",
  "Cross-assay concordance of community dissimilarity. **A**, Spearman correlations between corresponding Bray-Curtis dissimilarities from 12 matched samples (66 unique sample pairs) profiled by metagenomics (MG), metatranscriptomics (MT) and cDNA-derived 16S sequencing. **B**, Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted permutation FDR (BH) values. Circles show global sample-label tests using 99,999 random permutations; triangles show exact tests over all 1,296 cycle-label permutations within condition-by-phase strata. The dashed line denotes FDR (BH) = 0.05. Tests were two-sided and correction was applied across the three assay comparisons separately within each permutation scheme."
),file.path(out,"figures/FIGURE_CAPTION.md"))

stopifnot(identical(hashes,vapply(paths,sha,character(1))))
file.copy(paths[["notebook"]],file.path(out,"source.qmd"))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),file.path(out,"sessionInfo.txt"))
payload <- list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(payload,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(payload,sha,character(1))),
       file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
print(results)
```
